feature: MQTT QoS2 serial durable-session ReleaseFast comparison and profile
commands: MQTT_QOS=2 PUBLISHERS=1 SUBSCRIBERS=1 MESSAGES=5000 PUBLISHER_WINDOW=1 MQTT_SESSION_EXPIRY_SECONDS=3600 zig build compare-mqtt-mosquitto -Doptimize=ReleaseFast

hotspots.common.Waiter.wait / AnyTask.yield: 31.86% / 31.55% children; parking and wakeups remain dominant
hotspots.Broker.handlePubRel: 26.51% children, 2.46% self; durable session deliveries are written inline from the publisher task

conclusion: The ReleaseFast serial QoS2 gap is 0.54x. Time is spread across parking/wakeup, event-loop polling, packet reads and inline session writes rather than one hotspot. The earlier cached-clock extension remains the main latency win; closing the rest requires reducing per-packet task handoffs or event-loop syscall cost, not route/flush micro-optimizations.
